headline: Dry ladder, honest audit — studio answers the milestone question
lede: The builder checked every queue at eee3768 and found them empty: no queued games, no claimable feedback, no flagship gaps left unowned. Instead of inventing work, the shift answered Jon's milestone question with an evidence-backed proposal and clean handoff notes.

notes.text: Verified dry exit: halt/steer/next/game-queue/feedback all empty, flagshipStage null with real README inputs (SSX, Emberwood, Comet Drift HD, Myst gaps all CLOSED-by merged PRs), no resumeable corpses — main-ok green at eee3768.
